existing_rules: Preserve every current CORS rule and ResponseVary before appending reviewed additions.
notes: Fill exact HTTPS page origins or HTTP localhost development origins; no default wildcard.
CORS is bucket-wide browser behavior, not object authorization. Browser STS policies remain exact-key scoped.
Content-Length is browser controlled; do not try to set it from client JavaScript. Expose it for reads.
Authorization/x-cos-security-token support the installed COS browser SDK, x-cos-sdk-retry supports its retry path.
